_note: Verifiers are the checks the gates run (CANON.md ruling 16 as amended by ruling 17 of 2026-09-08: Claude writes them). Because the same party writes the tool and its check, each entry states the independent method or data the check rests on; a check that reuses the tool's own code is a stub with extra steps. The gate runner derives each status from the file on disk: missing (no file), stub (empty or carrying the '# STUB' marker), present; a present verifier is run as a gate step for its exit code.

verifiers.name: decode_check
verifiers.author: Claude
verifiers.checks: One Terrarium tile decodes to metres that match a known pixel (elevation_m = R*256 + G + B/256 - 32768).
verifiers.independent_of_the_tool_by: the published Terrarium encoding applied by hand to a cached tile's pixels, and a pixel over open sea that must decode to about zero; never imports Tools/data/terrarium.py

verifiers.name: region_stats
verifiers.author: Claude
verifiers.checks: The baked heights raster's min, max and sea fraction are plausible; refuses zero rows.
verifiers.independent_of_the_tool_by: reading the raw .r32 with numpy from the sidecar's stated shape alone, and plausibility bounds for this coast taken from published relief, not from the bake's own sidecar statistics

verifiers.name: summit_check
verifiers.author: Claude
verifiers.checks: Bherwerre Trig Point (170 m, a kilometre east of the box) reads as a summit in the surround and as the hill's flank in the region raster; the region's high ground is that hill and nowhere else; the east-west and north-south mirror images find only low ground; Jervis Bay and the ocean off Cave Beach are water; the ground north of the wake is land.
verifiers.independent_of_the_tool_by: coordinates and heights from Wikidata Q15107571, peakbagger.com, Parks Australia (booderee.gov.au) and beachesontheair.com, cited in the file, converted to raster cells by the frame rule the sidecar states rather than by the engine's code

verifiers.name: solar_check
verifiers.author: Claude
verifiers.checks: Sunrise, sunset, declination and the sun's place at the wake hour on day 237 at Bherwerre match an independent solar algorithm.
verifiers.independent_of_the_tool_by: the NOAA solar-position equations on the real date (Julian century, apparent ecliptic longitude, obliquity) against the engine's Spencer-series declination; the engine's line is read as text from the almanac tool, the engine is never imported

verifiers.name: station_table
verifiers.author: Claude
verifiers.checks: Parses hand-downloaded BoM CSVs for stations 068034 and 068072 into the calibration table.
verifiers.independent_of_the_tool_by: the Bureau's own CSVs, downloaded by the owner by hand because the Bureau blocks scripts (DEBTS.md); the table is checked against the station page by eye

verifiers.name: corpus_check
verifiers.author: Claude
verifiers.checks: Independently re-derives the corpus verdict from the raw result files and their mtimes, so the runner cannot grade itself.
verifiers.independent_of_the_tool_by: reading only the raw per-scenario result files and their modification times, never the runner's summary

verifiers.name: join_check
verifiers.author: Claude
verifiers.checks: Recomputes N1-N4 from the contracted run logs independently of the runner's own summary.
verifiers.independent_of_the_tool_by: recomputing every criterion from run.jsonl records alone, with the thresholds restated from CANON ruling 11 rather than imported from the harness
